scripts.text: Of course you're a volunteer for campaign to reclaim the Prontera Culvert. Would you let me warp you there?
Ah, let me inform you that the Capital Defense Headquarter of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom has now decided to recruit a punitive force due to the Prontera Culvert's situation.
The Prontera Culvert is infested with all kinds of filthy vermin!
Due to the serious risk of water contamination, and the safety of Rune-Midgartsians, the Culvert has been quarantined by royal decree.
Needless to say, this has caused shortages in the water supply in our kingdom. Indeed, such a crisis in these dark times...
Will you stand idly as the children of Rune-Midgarts suffer from parched throats and shed tears of dryness?! Would you bury our children?!
Warriors! Rune-Midgarts is calling you! Cleanse this land's pestilence and cast out the vermin in the Culvert! Only you... Can make a difference.
Hmpf. Well. The next time you take a drink of water, just remember that an average of nine and a half children just died... ^990000Of thirst^000000.
I would like to thank you for volunteering to do your part for our great kingdom. Here, take these provisions for your battles against the forces of darkness.
Ah, you're one of our volunteers. This is the entrance of the Prontera Culvert.
I'm sorry, but we can only allow volunteers for the Culvert Campaign to enter.
If you'd like to volunteer, please visit the ^000077Culvert Registrar^000000 located in the 11 O'clock direction of Prontera.

But that's not what I'm looking for. Maybe you need to study flowers a little bit?
Sometimes I regret what I did when I was younger, but it's not a big deal now. Through hard study, I finished entire educational courses earlier than all the other students.
I was sad and sometimes lonely. Whenever the studying got too hard, I needed someone who would listen to me. Finally, one day, I met my best friend.
When I saw a Pretty Flower blooming in the abandoned Garden, I realized It was my friend which shared my fate.
Although it is a Common and Normal Flower to others, she gave me the reason to study again. I could achieve my goals because of her.
I am trying to pay her back. Now I am studying Flowers, and plan to over the whole world with them.
I need bunches of flowers. But for someone who rarely goes outside, it is really hard to find all the flowers I need.
